title: A Boundary Integral Method for Generalized Impedance Boundary Conditions in 2D
summary: Generalized impedance boundary conditions for the Helmholtz equation arise in a number of acoustic and electromagnetic models that approximate boundary effects, including thin coatings and the viscous and thermal losses that can occur in boundary layers. Here we present a well-conditioned numerical method for this class of boundary conditions based on a boundary integral re-formulation of the equations.
